items.title: Io mi son giovenetta (Ferrabosco)
items.desc: Domenico Ferrabosco, Io mi son giovenetta, before 1543. 4 voices (Canto, Alto, Tenor, Basso), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
